verdict.rationale: Raygun's evidence shows integrations with Slack and PagerDuty for alerting (raygun-docs-16, raygun-docs-17), but there is no documentation of a general-purpose webhook subscription mechanism that would let an AI-native user programmatically subscribe to events. No API/webhook docs, no OpenAPI spec (raygun-probe-2 shows 404s), and no llms.txt (raygun-probe-1) to indicate agent-friendly event subscription.
